initialization: EXACT original per-policy first bridge/local odometry initialization; original chronological graph factor order
region: union of frozen local odometry +/-50m around removed endpoints, evaluated with ONE joint rigid alignment; no independent regional alignment
GT_inter_robot_error: fixed union372 measured pair IDs; CSV reference Pose3 convention unchanged from Stage22B; no new extrinsic assumption or retuning
GT_free_features: strict earlier P0 factor prefix, common-odometry linearization after first bridge; full joint cross-correlation; predicted measurement=current causal pose between, not actual current GICP transform
GT_free_scope: causal prefix-odometry proxy, not optimized ISAM2 posterior or calibrated physical uncertainty; observed current quality is separate realized diagnostic
map_cases: baselines, seven temporal groups, both common-only support groups and seven selected P5 removals; full LOO maps not regenerated
criticality_primary: signed delta joint ATE; regional metrics are paired same-cohort deltas; TopK positives require delta>0, no fitted materiality threshold
GT_freeze: GT-free feature file and all solve plans/results written before offline GT evaluator
GT_free_evaluation_pairs: all372 known union pairs; no unknown GICP imputation
